title: PCM: A Proof-Carrying Message Protocol for Verifiable Multi-Agent Communication
abstract: arXiv:2610.39109v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: When one AI agent tells another that "the tests passed" or "a person approved this refund", the receiver has only the sender's word. A2A and MCP authenticate the channel, but the sender is the party in doubt, so a prompt-injected agent can launder fabricated facts and authority through a multi-agent system. We present Proof-Carrying Messages (PCM), a protocol in which each claim carries evidence: records from an append-only Merkle log that the agent cannot write, with inclusion proofs, signed by an attesting signer the agent cannot control. Receivers check messages offline and give each claim a three-valued result: proven, unproven or failed. A claim that rests only on the agent's own report is never proven. Authority travels as grant chains rooted in a recorded human approval, and the chains can only narrow. translated_title: PCM：一种用于可验证多智能体通信的携带证明消息协议
translated_abstract: 当一个AI智能体告诉另一个智能体“测试已通过”或“某人已批准此退款”时，接收方只能听信发送方的一面之词。A2A和MCP对通信信道进行了身份验证，但发送方本身就是值得怀疑的一方，因此一个被提示注入攻击的智能体可以在多智能体系统中洗白捏造的事实和权限。我们提出了携带证明消息，这是一种协议，其中每条声明都携带证据：来自智能体无法写入的仅追加Merkle日志的记录，包含包含性证明，并由智能体无法控制的证明签名者进行签名。接收方可以离线检查消息，并为每条声明给出三值结果：已证明、未证明或失败。仅基于智能体自身报告的声明永远不会被判定为已证明。权限以授权链的形式传播，其根源于被记录下来的人类批准，且这些链只能被收窄。我们定义了四种声明类型、一个类型化的警告代数、能够在重启后依然有效的防重放规则，以及使独立（原文在此处截断）
tldr: PCM协议通过让智能体间的每条消息声明携带来自仅追加Merkle日志且由独立签名者签名的可验证证据，使接收方能离线验证声明的真伪（已证明/未证明/失败），从而防止被提示注入的智能体在多智能体系统中散布捏造的事实和滥用权限。
en_tdlr: PCM is a protocol in which each inter-agent message claim carries evidence from an append-only Merkle log signed by an independent attester, enabling receivers to verify claims offline with three-valued results and preventing prompt-injected agents from laundering fabricated facts and authority through multi-agent systems.
